form.title: Create action drafts
form.intro: Describe the outcome you need, then paste the original team conversation. Separate actions with a blank line.
form.contextPlaceholder: For example: identify work that needs follow-up and clarify owners, dates and next steps.
form.messagePlaceholder: Paste the original messages about work, ownership and timing.
form.hint: The system interprets the source with the request context. Review any field without clear evidence.
form.replace: Generating again replaces the current draft batch. Saved actions stay in the list.
